title: Ridgecrest RxSecure Premium Rate Schedule for the Contract Year
content:
Every Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is written at the monthly premium this schedule gives for the plan held. The premium is carried in two parts: the basic portion, attributable to basic Part D benefits, and the supplemental portion, attributable to enhanced benefits above the defined standard. The premium falls due on the day of the coverage month this schedule names, and the plan is billed on the cadence assigned to it at enrollment.

## Schedule of premiums

| Plan | Monthly plan premium (USD) | Basic portion (USD) | Supplemental portion (USD) | Premium due day of the coverage month | Billing cadence assigned at enrollment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 14.6 | 14.6 | 0.0 | 5 | monthly |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 23.9 | 20.3 | 3.6 | 5 | monthly |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 38.2 | 27.8 | 10.4 | 5 | monthly |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 52.7 | 33.1 | 19.6 | 1 | monthly |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 71.4 | 38.9 | 32.5 | 1 | quarterly |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 96.5 | 44.2 | 52.3 | 1 | quarterly |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The basic portion and the supplemental portion are the two parts of the monthly plan premium, and together they make it up. On Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) the basic portion of 20.3 USD together with the supplemental portion of 3.6 USD gives the monthly plan premium of 23.9 USD; on Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) the basic portion of 44.2 USD together with the supplemental portion of 52.3 USD gives 96.5 USD.
2. Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) carries no supplemental portion at all: its enhanced-benefit part is 0.0 USD, and its whole premium of 14.6 USD is basic.
3. The premium due day is a day of the coverage month, not a day counted from anything the member does. On the three plans written at a due day of 5 the premium for a coverage month falls due on the fifth of that month; on the three written at a due day of 1 it falls due on the first.
4. The cadence assigned at enrollment is the default this schedule gives for the plan: monthly on Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP), Value (PDP), Select (PDP) and Plus (PDP), and quarterly on Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP).
